summary: Golub Capital Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K disclosing routine monthly distributions and portfolio commentary. The Fund declared August 2026 regular distributions of $0.1875 per share for Class I and Class S shares (net $0.1704 for Class S after fees), payable on or about September 29, 2026. It also provided portfolio metrics as of July 31, 2026, including NAV per share of $24.21, total NAV of $4.3 billion, and portfolio fair value of $9.6 billion. This is a standard business update with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. No risk-arb angle; monitoring would involve ongoing fund performance and distribution sustainability.
